reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-10-01 review identified named banks and historical company balance certificates, not a EUROT-specific holdings snapshot dated 2026-07-30. Fresh issuer proof-of-reserves and WordPress media searches on 2026-10-02 still expose historical 2024 bank letters and no current token-specific reserve-to-liability reconciliation. Ziraat Participation Bank and Akbank remain the disclosed reserve banks; their current allocations and safeguarding terms are not established. No composition date is inferred from a document re-verification date.
